item.title: IDF assassinated the commander of the Iranian Navy in an IRGC safe house | This is how the US responded
item.description: Alireza Tangsiri was killed in Bandar Abbas, where he was attacked after Israel's Intelligence Agency was able to identify his location; security sources: 'He would have been commander of the Revolutionary Guards in a few years'; US: 'The region has become safer'

item.title: Deadly strike in Nahariya leaves 1 killed, 14 wounded; missile to central Israel intercepted
item.description: Multiple impacts in Nahariya after fire from Lebanon leave a man in his 30s dead, another critically wounded and 13 lightly hurt, with power outages reported; a missile from Iran was intercepted over central Israel

item.title: Children’s play center in north Israel devastated by Iranian missile strike
item.description: Shattered glass scattered among toys after Iranian cluster missile hits Kiryat Ata mall; play center owner says it is a miracle no children were inside as site prepared to reopen

item.title: קלוד תחת אש: טראמפ רוצה לזרוק, אבל הצבא חייב אותו
item.description: אחרי שהקריס את המניות של ענקיות הטק והציב איום על פרנסתם של המתכנתים, מודל ה–AI "קלוד" מחולל מהפכה גם במלחמה עם איראן ועוזר לצבא האמריקאי לשפר את הביצועים. אנת'רופיק, המפתחת שלו, מתעקשת להגדיר קווים מוסריים לשימוש בו ומוציאה את טראמפ מהכלים

item.title: 'Iran's revenge is best served cold': Gulf princes are caught in a trap
item.description: The Gulf is afraid of an agreement that will leave the ayatollah regime stronger, and the UAE and Saudi Arabia will support an escalation in the war - if Tehran does not accept significant restrictions on its missile, drone and nuclear programs.

item.title: Report: Pentagon drafts massive 'final blow' for Iran endgame, including ground option
item.description: Axios reports US officials are discussing scenarios ranging from large-scale airstrikes to possible ground operations and seizures of strategic islands and oil routes, as diplomacy stalls and tensions rise over the Strait of Hormuz

item.title: IDF commando killed in southern Lebanon as fighting intensifies
item.description: Military says Staff Sgt. Ori Greenberg, 21, killed in close-range clash with terrorists in southern Lebanon, as other troops seriously wounded by rocket and mortar fire and Hezbollah claims sharp escalation in attacks

item.title: This is how Iran responded to the 15-point peace proposal; Trump: 'They are begging to make a deal'
item.description: Iranian media reports on response to US proposal, without specifying how Tehran responded on the subject of its missile program or nuclear activities; among the Iranian demands: compensation, a promise that attacks will not resume and an end to the fighting in Lebanon as well

item.title: Sudden sirens turn a runner’s quiet moment in northern Israel into a sprint for safety
item.description: Nathan Hoffman was filming a quiet moment at a natural spring during a break in the rain when incoming sirens shattered the calm, capturing the jarring swing between routine and danger that has come to define daily life in wartime Israel

item.title: קפיצה בצריכת תרופות הרגעה ושינה ללא מרשם בימי המלחמה
item.description: נתוני קופות החולים ורשתות הפארם חושפים דפוס מוכר: עלייה ראשונית בתרופות מרשם לחרדה ודיכאון ולאחריה התייצבות מהירה. במקביל, מכבי פארם מדווחת על קפיצה של 18% ברכישת תרופות הרגעה ושינה ללא מרשם. "הציבור הגיע למערכה הזו מוכן יותר, אבל עדיין מחפש פתרון מיידי", מסביר ד"ר תנורי לימן ...
